advisor[0-9]+: The position of the advisor in the advisor list for this trial, [0-9]+
advisor[0-9]+actualType: Actual advice type offered by advisor [0-9]+ on this trial (the nominal type may not be possible to give)
advisor[0-9]+actualTypeFlag: Binary flag representation of the above
advisor[0-9]+advice: The target centre of advisor [0-9]+'s advice marker
advisor[0-9]+adviceCentre: The centre of the advice marker placed by advisor [0-9]+
advisor[0-9]+adviceConfidence: The confidence associated with the advisor's advice. Gives the width of the advisor's advice marker.
advisor[0-9]+adviceSide: The side marked as the advisor's answer (0=left, 1=right)
advisor[0-9]+adviceWidth: The width of the advice marker placed by advisor [0-9]+
advisor[0-9]+confidence: The width of the advice marker placed by advisor [0-9]+
advisor[0-9]+confidenceAddition: Amount of confidence added to the advisor[0-9]+'s calculated confidence before capping
advisor[0-9]+confidenceFunction: Name of the function used to derive the confidence of advisor[0-9]+
advisor[0-9]+confidenceFunctionParams: JSON representation of optional parameters specified for advisor[0-9]+'s confidenceFunction
advisor[0-9]+confidenceVariation: The amount of variation around the centre of the advice distribution characterising advisor [0-9]+'s advice
advisor[0-9]+group: The group to which advisor [0-9]+ belongs
advisor[0-9]+hybridDescriptions: Pipe-separated list of advisor [0-9]+'s descriptions encompassed if a hybrid
advisor[0-9]+hybridIds: Pipe-separated list of advisor [0-9]+'s ids encompassed if a hybrid
advisor[0-9]+idDescription: The desciption of advisor [0-9]+'s advice style
advisor[0-9]+introImage: Whether and how advisor [0-9]+'s image is shown alongside their introText. NA=no image; "speech"=image with text in speech bubble
advisor[0-9]+introText: The text with which advisor [0-9]+ is introduced to the participant
advisor[0-9]+name: The name advisor [0-9]+ displays to the participant
advisor[0-9]+nominalType: Advice type selected by advisor [0-9]+ for this trial
advisor[0-9]+nominalTypeFlag: Binary flag representation of the above
advisor[0-9]+pCorFunction: String representation of the function used to derive advisor[0-9]+'s p(correct) from the absolute difference between anchor and their advice
advisor[0-9]+questionnaire: The questionnaire associated with the advice, expanded in advisor[0-9]+questionnaire.+ variables
advisor[0-9]+questionnaireHonestyLabel: The text of the option above
advisor[0-9]+questionnaireHonestyPrompt: The text presented to the participant as the question for the advice questionnaire for advisor [0-9]+'s advice
advisor[0-9]+questionnaireHonestyValue: The option selected by the participant as the answer to the advice question about advisor [0-9]+'s advice
advisor[0-9]+questionnaireTimeOpen: Milliseconds from the beginning of the trial to the opening of the advice questionnaire window for advisor [0-9]+'s advice
advisor[0-9]+questionnaireTimeSubmitted: Milliseconds from the beginning of the trial to the participant's submission of the advice questionnaire window for advisor [0-9]+'s advice
advisor[0-9]+sameGroup: Whether advisor [0-9]+ is in the same group as the participant
advisor[0-9]+side: The side marked as advisor [0-9]+'s advice (0=left, 1=right)
advisor[0-9]+svg: The img element src field containing base64-encoded svg file for advisor [0-9]+'s portrait
advisor[0-9]+validFlags: Binary flag representation of advice types which advisor [0-9]+ may select for this trial
advisor[0-9]+validTypeFlags: Binary flag representation of the above
advisor[0-9]+validTypes: Comma-separated list of advice types which advisor [0-9]+ may select for this trial
advisorChoice: Whether the trial offers a choice of advisor
advisorOptions: Comma-separated list of ids for the available advisor options
anchorHTML: HTML displayed in the anchor date area
block: The number of the experimental block the trial is in
clientTime: Timestamp of the request to write this CSV line, according to the participant's computer
confidenceConfidenceFinal: Confidence of the participant's final response
confidenceTimeConfidence: Timestamp of the time the participant's confidence response was submitted
confidenceTimeConfidenceFinal: Timestamp of the time the participant's final confidence response was submitted
context: Equivalent of advisor group for the whole trial
contextDescription: Equivalent of advisor introText for the whole trial
contextName: Equivalent of advisor idDescription for the whole trial
correctAnswer: The correct answer to the stimulus
correctAnswerSide: Whether the correct answer side is the left (0) or right (1)
isAttentionCheck: Whether the trial is an attention check
pid: 8-character alphanumeric hash uniquely identifying a participant within an experiment
pidHash: md5 hash generated from participant's ProlificID and study info allowing one-way verification that a given ProlificID was responsible for the data
responseAns: The label of the submitted response as seen by the participant
responseAnsFinal: The label of the submitted final response as seen by the participant
responseAnswer: The label of the submitted response as seen by the participant
responseAnswerFinal: The label of the submitted final response as seen by the participant
responseAnswerSide: The side of the response selected (0=left, 1=right)
responseAnswerSideFinal: The side of the final response selected (0=left, 1=right)
responseComplete: Whether the response was completed successfully
responseCompleteFinal: Whether the final response was completed successfully
responseConfidence: The confidence associated with the response
responseConfidenceFinal: The confidence associated with the final response
responseEstimateLabelLeft: The text of the label the participant sees, should match responseEstimateLeft
responseEstimateLabelLeftFinal: The text of the label the participant sees for the final response, should match responseEstimateLeft
responseEstimateLabelRight: The text of the right-hand label the participant sees, should match responseEstimateLeft+responseMarkerWidth
responseEstimateLabelRightFinal: The text of the right-hand label the participant sees for the final response, should match responseEstimateLeft+responseMarkerWidth
responseEstimateLeft: The left-hand edge of the response marker in years
responseEstimateLeftFinal: The left-hand edge of the response marker in years for the final response
responseLabels: Comma-separated list of labels attached to the response options (left, right)
responseLabelsFinal: Comma-separated list of labels attached to the final response options (left, right)
responseMarker: Width of the marker used in the response
responseMarkerFinal: Width of the marker used in the final response
responseMarkerValue: The points to be awarded for a correct response using the selected marker
responseMarkerValueFinal: The points to be awarded for a correct response using the selected marker for the final response
responseMarkerWidth: The width of the response marker in years
responseMarkerWidthFinal: The width of the response marker in years for the final response
responseSlider: Whether the slider used in the response was "before" (on the left, 0) or "after" (right, 1)
responseSliderFinal: Whether the slider used in the final response was "before" (on the left, 0) or "after" (right, 1)
responseTimeEstimate: The time elapsed in milliseconds between the opening of the response window and the collection of the response
responseTimeEstimateFinal: The time elapsed in milliseconds between the opening of the response window and the collection of the final response
serverTime: Time of the entry according to the server
stimHTML: HTML displayed in the stimulus area
timeConfidenceOpen: Milliseconds from the beginning of the trial to the opening of the confidence report
timeConfidenceOpenFinal: Milliseconds from the beginning of the trial to the opening of the final confidence report
timeConfidenceClose: Milliseconds from the beginning of the trial to the closing of the confidence report
timeConfidenceCloseFinal: Milliseconds from the beginning of the trial to the closing of the final confidence report
timeEnd: Milliseconds from the beginning of the trial to the end of the trial
timeFeedbackOff: Milliseconds from the beginning of the trial to the end of the trial feedback (NA if no feedback provided)
timeFeedbackOn: Milliseconds from the beginning of the trial to the start of the trial feedback (NA if no feedback provided)
timeResponseClose: Milliseconds from the beginning of the trial to the end of the response phase
timeResponseOpen: Milliseconds from the beginning of the trial to the start of the response phase
timeResponseOpenFinal: Milliseconds elapsed between the start of the trial and the opening of the final response window
timestampStart: Timestamp of the start of the trial, according to the participant's computer
timeStimOff: Milliseconds from the beginning of the trial to the stimulus offset
timeStimOn: Milliseconds from the beginning of the trial to the stimulus onset
